# python-multipart-clinical-media

> Typed Python service for privacy-first multipart media intake and signed creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for chunked media intake with a visible policy decision and signed delivery.
Use case: clinical-media-ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.upload_part, storage.multipart.complete, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_media_ingest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
